description.raw: Thoran charges up for a moment to slash at enemies within range, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage plus 180% (ATK-based) of the damage received during the charge. He also gains 20% Life Drain. Thoran is Unaffected while casting this skill.
active: Thoran charges up for a moment to slash at enemies within range, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage plus 180% (ATK-based) of the damage received during the charge.
Thoran is Unaffected while casting this skill.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases additional damage to 200% (ATK-based) of the damage received during the charge.
Unlocks at level 111: Thoran's soul will complete the slash if this skill is interrupted.
Unlocks at level 171: Increases additional damage to 220% (ATK-based) of the damage received during the charge.
Unlocks at level 231: Increases additional damage to 240% (ATK-based) of the damage received during the charge.

description.raw: Thoran targets the non-soul-plundered enemy with the highest HP and drains 18% + 1.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP to increase his max HP by the same amount. He also causes this target to receive 13% more damage for the rest of the battle. Drained HP limit: 600% (ATK-based) of Thoran's ATK.
active: Thoran targets the non-soul-plundered enemy with the highest HP and drains 18% + 1.5% (SP-based) of the target's current HP to increase his max HP by the same amount.
He also causes this target to receive 13% more damage for the rest of the battle.
Drained HP limit: 600% (ATK-based) of Thoran's ATK.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Increases drained HP to 20% + 1.5% (SP-based) of the enemy's current HP.
Unlocks at level 131: Increases the enemy's received damage to 16% for the rest of the battle.
Unlocks at level 191: Increases the enemy's received damage to 17% for the rest of the battle.
Enhancement: Thoran's Ultimate drains an additional 20% of the current HP from all enemies affected by Soul Plunder to increase his max HP by the same amount.

description.raw: Thoran will resurrect with 40% (HP-based) + 4% (SP-based) HP restored after a short time when defeated. This effect can be triggered once per battle.
active: Thoran will resurrect with 40% (HP-based) + 4% (SP-based) HP restored after a short time when defeated.
This effect can be triggered once per battle.

text: Unlocks at level 91: Thoran can revive himself with 50% (HP-based) + 4% (SP-based) HP.
Unlocks at level 151: Thoran can revive himself with 60% (HP-based) + 4% (SP-based) HP.
Unlocks at level 211: Gains 500 Energy when the skill is triggered.

description.raw: Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery by 24%. His Energy Recovery is increased by an extra 6% when Resurrection is not triggered.
active: Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery by 24%.
His Energy Recovery is increased by an extra 6% when Resurrection is not triggered.

text: Increases Energy Recovery to 32%; additional increase when Resurrection is not triggered to 8%.
Increases Energy Recovery to 40%; additional increase when Resurrection is not triggered to 10%.

description.raw: Before a battle starts, Thoran signs a pact with the ally 1 tile behind him, agreeing to take 50% of the damage for this ally until the battle ends. When Thoran takes a fatal blow, this ally sacrifices 85% of their current HP to save and heal Thoran by 150% of this amount. After that, Thoran no longer takes damage for this ally.
active: Before a battle starts, Thoran signs a pact with the ally on the tile behind him, agreeing to take 50% of the damage for this ally until the battle ends.
When Thoran is defeated, this ally sacrifices 85% of their current HP to save and heal Thoran by 150% of this portion of HP.
After that, Thoran no longer takes damage for this ally.

text: 25% of the damage dealt by this ally heals Thoran when the pact exists.
Increases the healing amount that Thoran receives from the ally's damage dealt to 30%.
Increases the healing amount that Thoran receives from the ally's damage dealt to 35%.

description.raw: Thoran drains another 20% of the current HP from all enemies affected by Soul Plunder when casting Soul Retaliation, increasing his max HP by the same amount.
active: Thoran drains another 20% of the current HP from all enemies affected by Soul Plunder when casting Soul Retaliation, increasing his max HP by the same amount.
